plugin.note: Best regular-task method is Venator bow plus dwarf multicannon in the eastern task-only cave's south-west room. Keep 30 kg equipped for normal Gryphons; bring a tortugan shield for Dire gryphons and Shellbane.

requirements: 45 Sailing access to the Great Conch
Wings Spread unlock for Nieve/Steve or Duradel/Kuradal assignments
Bigger and Badder for Dire gryphon superior spawns
Tortugan shield for Dire gryphons and Shellbane Gryphon
Dwarf multicannon for the recommended regular-task method
mechanics: Normal Gryphons attack with melee and have a knockback special if equipped weight is too low.
Normal Gryphons need about 30 kg equipped weight to avoid taking damage from the knockback special.
Dire gryphons and Shellbane Gryphon use a 40 kg equipped-weight threshold.
If the weight threshold is met, the Gryphon stuns itself.
After a normal Gryphon stuns itself, clicking it within 2 ticks knocks it back and grants one extra attack without attack delay.
Missing the counterattack is not punished on normal Gryphons, unlike the boss and superior variants.
Normal Gryphons do not require a tortugan shield.
Dire gryphons and Shellbane Gryphon require a tortugan shield to avoid frequent moderate damage even through prayer.
Gryphons are weakest to melee, ideally stab attacks, and have a 50% elemental weakness to air spells.
The eastern and western caves each have one southern multicombat, cannonable room.

methods.label: Requirements and unlocks
methods.summary: Confirm Great Conch access and Slayer unlock state before choosing a master or boss path.
recommendedFor: Players deciding whether to toggle Nieve or Duradel assignments
steps: Complete Troubled Tortugans and unlock Great Conch access through Sailing before planning the task.
Use Vannaka or Chaeldar without Wings Spread if only the quest requirement is met.
Buy Wings Spread for 80 Slayer points only if Nieve or Duradel Gryphon assignments are desired.
Use Gryphon and on to add 80 kills to the assignment when extended Gryphon trips are desirable.
Use Bigger and Badder only if superior Dire gryphon spawns are desired.
notes: The task page recommends Vannaka for players seeking Gryphon tasks because they are his highest weighted task.
The task page advises avoiding Nieve/Duradel toggles if not planning to kill the boss because regular Gryphons have poor drops.

methods.label: Weight and knockback
methods.summary: Meet the equipped-weight threshold so Gryphon specials stun themselves instead of damaging and knocking back the player.
requiredOrKeyItems: 30 kg equipped weight for normal Gryphons
40 kg equipped weight for Dire gryphons or Shellbane
steps: Keep at least 30 kg equipped weight for normal Gryphons.
Keep at least 40 kg equipped weight for Dire gryphons and Shellbane Gryphon.
If the special fails against the weight threshold, click the Gryphon within 2 ticks to knock it back one tile and perform an extra attack without attack delay.
Use black mask (i), granite ring, or avernic treads (max) to reach 30 kg in high-end ranged gear if needed.
Bring a tortugan shield for superior and boss variants; normal Gryphons do not require it.
risks: Low equipped weight causes knockback and moderate damage.
Dire gryphons and Shellbane can deal frequent damage through prayer without tortugan shield protection.

methods.label: Eastern cannon Venator
methods.summary: Kill regular Gryphons in the eastern task-only cave's south-west multicombat room with Venator bow and cannon.
steps: Use the south-western multicombat room of the eastern task-only cave.
Place and maintain a dwarf multicannon because the room is cannonable.
Use Venator bow as the recommended ranged weapon from the task page.
Keep equipped weight at or above 30 kg while ranging.
Bring a tortugan shield for any Dire gryphon superior spawn.
Use the western cave safespot if avoiding all attacks is preferred over the eastern cannon method.
risks: Low-weight ranged setups can trigger damaging knockback specials.

methods.label: Melee heavy gear
methods.summary: Use heavier melee gear when not safespotting; Gryphons are weakest to melee, ideally stab.
steps: Use melee if not safespotting, because melee armour makes the weight threshold easier to reach.
Prefer stab where possible because Gryphons are weakest to melee, ideally stabbing attacks.
Use Protect from Melee for normal attacks.
Keep a tortugan shield ready for Dire gryphon spawns.
Use air spells only as an alternative despite the 50% air weakness, because the task page notes melee is typically stronger.
notes: Normal Gryphons do not require tortugan shield, but it is generally useful because of its weight.

methods.label: Dire gryphon superior
methods.summary: Handle Dire gryphons like a tougher Gryphon with boss-like protection requirements.
steps: Equip a tortugan shield before fighting Dire gryphons.
Maintain at least 40 kg equipped weight to counter the pick-up special.
Counterattack after the special is stunned; Dire gryphons can still throw the player backwards if the counterattack is missed.
Expect tougher stats than normal Gryphons but a similar drop table.
Use a cannon where the spawn and room allow it because Dire gryphons are cannonable.
risks: Without tortugan shield, Dire gryphon attacks are devastating and cause heavy damage.
Missing the counterattack is punished more than with normal Gryphons.

methods.label: Shellbane choice
methods.summary: Choose Shellbane Gryphon only when accepting a solo instanced boss trip instead of regular task kills.
recommendedFor: Players intentionally killing the Gryphons boss
Players accepting slower task progress for boss loot
steps: Use the central Shellbane Gryphon Cave on the Great Conch for the boss variant.
Only attack Shellbane while on a Gryphon task.
Expect a solo instanced boss using melee, ranged, and two avoidable special attacks.
Use the dedicated Shellbane Gryphon strategy for boss-specific positioning and gear.
Avoid toggling Gryphons for Nieve or Duradel if neither regular nor boss Gryphon loot is desired.
notes: The task page says Shellbane drops are somewhat lackluster but slightly better than normal Gryphons.
Choose the Shellbane Gryphon variant to use its dedicated strategy, equipment, location and preparation requirements.

methods.label: Inventory and loot
methods.summary: Bring cannon supplies, weight-support gear, superior protection, and enough supplies for task-only cave trips.
inventory: Venator bow or chosen ranged weapon
Tortugan shield for Dire gryphons and Shellbane
Weight-support item such as black mask (i), granite ring, or avernic treads (max)
Food for knockback mistakes or superior spawns
Prayer potions if using offensive prayers
Optional air runes if testing the 50% air weakness
steps: Prioritise task-only eastern cave kills for the recommended cannon method.
Use the western cave safespot when prioritising safety.
Pick up Gryphon feathers and Horn of plenty rolls if desired.
Remember Horn of plenty is rarer off task than on task.
notes: Regular Gryphon drops are poor compared with many other Slayer tasks.
